What does it take to be ready for an F1 seat without racing every weekend?
Mercedes reserve driver Frederik Vesti breaks down life behind the scenes, from simulator work and car development to staying ready to replace George Russell or Kimi Antonelli at a moment’s notice. He also talks about why simulator correlation matters, whether esports drivers can make the jump to F1, and how AI could shape the future of the sport.
